item.title: Build 700
item.description: • Choose how often Slack is checked, and when. Settings, Connections, Slack now starts with the timing rather than hiding it under the channel list. Pick an interval from every 5 minutes to every 4 hours, and turn on Only in working hours to check on weekdays between the times you set (9:00 to 5:00 to begin with). The interval is now a limit on every automatic check: switching back to Mayfly no longer reads Slack on its own. Sync now still reads it straight away whenever you press it.
